Title: SyntheholDB | Generate Production grade synthetic data in minutes | Product Hunt
# SyntheholDB. ## Generate Production grade synthetic data in minutes. ### Engineering & Development. ### LLMs. ### Productivity. ### Marketing & Sales. ### Design & Creative. ### Social & Community. ### Finance. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. I own GTM for SyntheholDB, so I've stress-tested it from both the commercial and technical side. The core problem we kept hitting was demo environment fidelity. Prospects in fintech and healthcare want to see their data model reflected in the demo realistic distributions, correct relational structure, edge cases that match their domain. Handwriting that kind of seed data is slow and breaks the moment the schema shifts. Copying production is faster but immediately creates a compliance surface you can't defend in a regulated sales cycle. SyntheholDB solves this at the architecture layer, not the policy layer. You feed it a schema plain English or CSV and it generates relationally consistent rows where foreign keys resolve correctly, value distributions reflect your business logic, and statistical patterns hold across linked tables. The built-in PII detection scan runs pre-export, so nothing that resembles a real identifier makes it into the output. For a GTM workflow specifically, the impact was immediate. Demo environments that used to take a day to seed properly now take under five minutes. CI pipeline test data stays in sync with schema changes without manual fixture updates. And sales calls into HIPAA and GDPR regulated accounts got significantly cleaner because the compliance conversation around demo data essentially disappears. Free tier is live, no card neede, genuinely worth ten minutes of your time.
